decisions.name: Victoria
decisions.reason: The original UN WUP 2025 row identifies city code 4 as Victoria, Canada, at 48.445978670856 N, -123.360034699349 E with 250244 persons. The prior Victoria research explicitly identifies the Seychelles capital (SC), and its bounded official ArcGIS parcel sample lies around 55.45 E, -4.62 N. Canadian parcel custody, public geometry and runtime qualification remain unresolved.
